utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Good afternoon to everyone in the courtroom and those just outside the courtroom assisting us. Mr. Registrar, would you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honours. This is case number IT-00-39-T, the Prosecutor versus Momcilo Krajisnik.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: We finished yesterday in closed session. We opened today in open session, but not for a long time, since protective measures are in effect in respect of the next witness to testify, and that testimony will be received through means of videolink under Rule 71 bis of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence. Is there anything we should discuss at this moment in open court? If not, I'll ask the usher to let the curtains down, and at the same time, ask Mr. Registrar whether the videolink is effective

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Friday, the 18th day of June, 2004, at 9.00 a.m. 19 20 21 22 23 24 25

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 7.02 p.m.,
